stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.summary: Boeing's stock declined following a U.S. regulatory delay in certifying the 737 MAX 10 aircraft. A software issue could prevent pilots from accessing automated flight guidance systems.

stories.title: Stelco to lay off hundreds of steel workers in Hamilton as it shifts focus to Lake Erie Works
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Stelco to lay off hundreds of steel workers in Hamilton as it shifts focus to Lake Erie Works
en.summary: Stelco is laying off hundreds of steel workers at its Hamilton facility as it reallocates operations toward its Lake Erie Works location. The U.S. parent company plans to offer positions at Lake Erie Works to many of the affected employees.
